name: Vietnam (Democratic Republic, 1945–1955)
description: A red field with a large yellow five-pointed star in the centre, its points drawn at a wider angle than on the present flag.
history: The Viet Minh flag proclaimed a national flag at Tân Trào on 17 August 1945 and adopted for the Democratic Republic of Vietnam by decree of 5 September 1945, with the star's points set at a more obtuse angle. On 30 November 1955 the design was modified to make the star smaller with straighter rays, producing the present flag.
